title: Global, regional and national burden of cervical cancer in 1990–2023 with forecasts to 2050: a Global Burden of Disease study
Industrialization drives convergent microbiome and host physiological shifts in the human metaorganism
summary_zh: 研究显示工业化导致人类元生物体微生物组和宿主生理变化。方法上，分析全球微生物组保守协会队列的多变量数据。实验表明，工业化与微生物组成同质化、多样性降低和社区稳定性下降相关。
summary_en: This study shows that industrialization drives convergent microbiome and host physiological shifts in the human metaorganism. The method involves analyzing multivariate data from the Global Microbiome Conservancy cohort. Experiments indicate that industrialization is associated with homogenized microbial compositions, reduced microbial diversity, and lower community stability.
insights: 创新点：揭示了工业化对微生物组和生理的影响
方法亮点：分析全球微生物组保守协会队列的多变量数据
关键发现：工业化与微生物组成同质化和多样性降低相关
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the impact of industrialization on the microbiome and physiology
Method highlight: Analyzes multivariate data from the Global Microbiome Conservancy cohort
Key finding: Industrialization associated with homogenized microbiome composition and reduced diversity
abstract: Understanding how host lifestyle and industrialization shape the human gut microbiome and intestinal physiology requires multimodal analyses across diverse global host contexts. Here, we generate multivariate data from the Global Microbiome Conservancy cohort, including gut microbiome, IgA-sequencing, host genotyping, diet, lifestyle and fecal biomarker profiles, to investigate host-microbiome interactions across gradients of industrialization and geography. We show that industrialization is associated with homogenized microbial compositions, reduced microbial diversity, and lower community stability, independent of host confounders. We further show that industrialization is linked to elevated markers of gut stress, increased IgA secretion, and altered patterns of IgA-bacteria interactions. Finally, we show that microbiome-based disease predictors trained on industrialized populations lose accuracy in less industrialized cohorts, highlighting limited cross-population transferability. Together, our results suggest profound restructuring of host-microbiome interactions due to industrialized lifestyles, and emphasize the need for inclusive, globally representative data to improve translational microbiome applications across diverse human populations.

title: Convergent genomic evolution of human gut bacteria along an industrialization gradient
summary_zh: 研究调查工业化梯度上人类肠道细菌的基因组适应性。方法上，收集了来自不同地区、生活方式和菌株的基因组。实验表明，工业化宿主的菌株经历蛋白质组大小的扩张和更大的泛基因组流动性。
summary_en: This study investigates the genomic adaptation of human gut bacteria along an industrialization gradient. The method involves collecting genomes from diverse host geographies, lifestyles, species, and strains. Experiments show that strains from industrialized hosts experience an expansion of proteome size and greater pangenome fluidity.
insights: 创新点：揭示了工业化对肠道细菌基因组的影响
方法亮点：收集了广泛样本的基因组
关键发现：工业化宿主菌株蛋白质组扩张和泛基因组流动性增加
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the impact of industrialization on the gut bacteria genome
Method highlight: Collected genomes from a wide range of samples
Key finding: Strains from industrialized hosts show expanded proteome size and increased pangenome fluidity
abstract: To what extent gut bacteria respond to the distinct ecological pressures imposed by human lifestyle remains unclear. Here, we investigate how genomic adaptation in gut bacteria differ between industrialized and non-industrialized human populations. We generated a broad collection of isolate genomes spanning diverse host geographies, lifestyles, species, and strains. We first found that compared to MAGs, paired isolate genomes recover more functional elements and signals of horizontal gene transfers (HGTs). Leveraging isolate genomes from multiple species, we find that strains from industrialized hosts experience an expansion of proteome size and harbor greater pangenome fluidity, driven by recent events of HGTs. Gene- and variant-level analyses reveal convergent patterns of lifestyle-specific adaptation in functions that are critical for ecological adaptation, such as stress response, cell envelope remodeling and central metabolism. Our results demonstrate that industrialization imprints evolutionary signatures on gut bacterial genomes, illuminating the effects of rapidly changing environments on human biology.

title: Intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters serve as sites of local costimulation to enhance CTL-mediated tumor rejection
summary_zh: 研究肿瘤内cDC1-T细胞簇作为局部共刺激位点，增强CTL介导的肿瘤排斥。采用STAMP模型，发现cDC1s和T细胞的分布决定肿瘤是否被排斥。
summary_en: This study investigates intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters as sites of local costimulation to enhance CTL-mediated tumor rejection. Using the STAMP model, we found that the spatial distribution of cDC1s and T cells determines whether a tumor can be rejected.
insights: 创新点：揭示了肿瘤内cDC1-T细胞簇在肿瘤排斥中的作用
方法亮点：采用STAMP模型研究肿瘤免疫反应
关键发现：cDC1s和T细胞的分布决定肿瘤排斥
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the role of intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters in tumor rejection
Method highlight: Utilizes the STAMP model to study tumor immune responses
Key finding: The distribution of cDC1s and T cells determines tumor rejection
abstract: Summary T cells are essential for anti-tumor immunity, but their ability to eliminate tumors depends on coordinated interactions with type 1 conventional dendritic cells (cDC1s). While cDC1s are known for cross-presenting tumor-derived antigens in lymph nodes to prime CD8+ T cells, their role within the tumor itself remains less well understood. Here, we use the Skin Tumor Array by Micro-Poration (STAMP) model to investigate how cDC1-T cell interactions shape immune responses and influence tumor fate. Our data reveal that it is the spatial distribution of both cDC1s and T cells that determines whether a tumor can be rejected. We defined three primary immunotypes based on the spatial distribution of T cells and cDC1s: T cell-inflamed/dendritic cell-inflamed (TC-In/DC-In) tumors, where T cells and cDC1s co-infiltrate the tumor; T cell-inflamed/dendritic cell-excluded (TC-In/DC-Ex) tumors, where T cells infiltrate but cDC1s remain at the periphery; and T cell-excluded/dendritic cell-excluded (TC-Ex/DC-Ex) tumors, which lack both cDC1 and T cell infiltration. Notably, TC-In/DC-In tumors are more likely to undergo rejection, whereas TC-In/DC-Ex tumors persist despite T cell infiltration. Within TC-In/DC-In tumors, cDC1s engage in direct interactions with T cells, upregulate co-stimulatory molecules, and sustain effector T cell responses, while cDC1s in TC-In/DC-Ex tumors express higher migration-associated genes, suggesting a propensity to exit the tumor. We further show that chemokine modulation, particularly through CXCL9, CCL5, and XCL1, can reshape immune infiltration patterns to promote intra-tumoral cDC1-T cell clustering and improve tumor rejection. These findings underscore the unexpectedly important role of cDC1 positioning and function in sustaining effective anti-tumor immunity and highlight spatially organized cDC1-T cell clusters as critical hubs for local T cell activation.

title: Transcranial magnetic stimulation to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex modulates single-neuron activity in humans
summary_zh: 经颅磁刺激dlPFC调节人类单神经元活动。研究发现TMS可引发神经元时间锁定的放电响应。
summary_en: Transcranial magnetic stimulation to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex modulates single-neuron activity in humans. The study finds that TMS elicits time-locked firing responses in neurons.
insights: 创新点：揭示TMS对人类神经元活动的影响
方法亮点：使用颅内微电极记录技术
关键发现：TMS引发神经元放电响应
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the effect of TMS on human neuron activity
Method highlight: Utilizes intracranial microelectrode recording technology
Key finding: TMS elicits neuron firing responses
abstract: Abstract Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) is an FDA-cleared treatment for depression, yet how cortical stimulation influences single neurons in deep brain circuits remains unknown. Using intracranial microelectrode recordings in four neurosurgical patients, we resolved single-neuron spikes as early as 8 ms from 185 single neurons after single-pulse left dlPFC TMS. TMS elicited time-locked firing responses in 46% of neurons across deep cortical and subcortical structures bilaterally. TMS facilitated putative interneuron spiking in striato-thalamic regions from ∼8 ms, peaking at ∼80-100 ms, and lasting to ∼1000 ms, while suppressing putative pyramidal cell spiking with a delayed and slower time course. Trial-by-trial single-neuron modulations were positively correlated with cortico-striato-thalamic network activity and anti-correlated with limbic network activity. These findings reveal that dlPFC TMS facilitates inhibitory firing in executive control networks while suppressing limbic excitatory drive, providing a cellular mechanism for how cortical stimulation modulates distributed brain networks.

title: Senescent CD8 T effector memory cells are functionally impaired, enriched in aging and disease, and a barrier to immunotherapy
summary_zh: 研究揭示了衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞在衰老和疾病中富集，并成为免疫治疗的障碍。单细胞RNA测序揭示了这些细胞的功能受损。
summary_en: This study reveals that senescent CD8 T effector memory cells are enriched in aging and disease and act as a barrier to immunotherapy. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the functional impairment of these cells.
insights: 创新点：揭示了衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞在衰老和疾病中的富集
方法亮点：单细胞RNA测序揭示了这些细胞的功能受损
关键发现：衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞成为免疫治疗的障碍
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the enrichment of senescent CD8 T effector memory cells in aging and disease
Method highlight: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the functional impairment of these cells
Key finding: Senescent CD8 T effector memory cells act as a barrier to immunotherapy
abstract: Senescent cells play important roles in various biological processes that promote fitness and health; however, their timely elimination by immune cells is critical to maintain tissue homeostasis and prevent disease. Despite this, senescent cells accumulate systemically with age, suggesting that certain immune cells also become senescent and dysfunctional during aging. In support of this, we previously demonstrated that CD8 T cells, immune cells capable of targeting senescent cells, increasingly develop characteristics of senescence with advancing age in humans. Here, we characterized the senescence state of human SA-βGal-expressing (SA-βGal high ) CD8 T effector memory (EM) cells, their functional capabilities, and their enrichment in aging and disease. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that SA-βGal high CD8 T cells with unique transcriptional signatures develop in all stages of T cell differentiation, including in CD8 T EM cells, which increased in abundance with human aging. SA-βGal high CD8 T EM cells expressed various classical markers of senescence and were significantly impaired in their ability to proliferate, produce cytokines, and eliminate senescent human stromal cells. Gene signatures of senescent SA-βGal high CD8 T EM cells were enriched in CD8 T cells from older human donors, patients with age-related disorders, cancer, and in smokers. Furthermore, we show that T cell senescence is distinct from and dominant over T cell exhaustion, limiting the response of CD8 T EM cells to immune checkpoint blockade. Collectively, our study demonstrates that senescence impairs CD8 T EM cell function and reveals the involvement of senescent and dysfunctional CD8 T EM cells in aging, disease, smoking, and responses to immunotherapy.

title: Cooling fast and slow: Characterizing the effects of vitrification in cryo-EM and the subsequent recovery of equilibrium populations
summary_zh: 研究冷冻电镜中玻璃化对生物分子集合的影响。通过分子动力学模拟分析不同冷却速率。发现冷却速率影响蛋白质结构。
summary_en: Investigates the impact of vitrification on biomolecular ensembles in cryo-EM. Conducts molecular dynamics simulations at various cooling rates. Finds cooling rate affects protein structure.
insights: 冷却速率影响蛋白质结构
分子动力学模拟揭示冷却效应
玻璃化过程对生物分子集合有显著影响
insights_en: Cooling rate affects protein structure
Molecular dynamics simulations reveal cooling effects
Vitrification process significantly affects biomolecular ensembles
abstract: Abstract Single-particle cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has enabled near-atomic resolution structure determination of diverse biomolecules. Because the high vacuum required for electron microscopy prevents the imaging of liquid-phase samples, cryo-EM samples are prepared by plunging the sample into a cryogen, rapidly cooling the sample and suspending the ensemble of biomolecules in a matrix of water glass. However, the effects of this vitrification on the biomolecular ensemble are unknown, complicating efforts to use cryo-EM to derive conformational ensembles of biomolecules. To study these effects, we carried out extensive molecular dynamics simulations (over 50 milliseconds) of the Trp-cage miniprotein at equilibrium and undergoing rapid cooling. We simulated seven cooling rates spanning three orders of magnitude, with the slowest coolings matching experimental rates. By inspecting molecular mobility and density-temperature equations of state for water with and without protein, we found that water vitrification is unaltered by the protein. To track protein conformation changes, and to relate them to conformational kinetics, we made a Markov State Model (MSM) of Trp-cage from 5.4 milliseconds of equilibrium sampling at 277 K. We observed that MSM states with a characteristic time longer than the duration of the non-equilibrium cooling, tend to be more robust to artefacts induced by such cooling. Critically, although we observe that some states vanish in the equilibrium ensemble at 230 K, none do in our nonequilibrium cooled ensembles. However, to account for perturbations induced by nonequilibrium cooling for more labile states, we developed a thermodynamic inference framework for recovering equilibrium populations from the measured vitrified ensembles. These results indicate that cryo-EM has the capacity to be a reliable and accurate biophysical technique for the study of biomolecular ensembles. Significance Cryogenic electron microscopy images biomolecules trapped in vitreous ice. To vitrify the sample, it must be cooled over the course of 22 microseconds. However, the degree to which this cooling causes the ensemble of the molecules to be perturbed from equilibrium is unknown. Here we present extensive molecular dynamics simulations to quantify the equilibrium dynamics of the Trp-cage miniprotein and the effects of cooling on its conformational ensemble. By simulating cooling at seven different rates, including the slowest experimental rates that still result in vitrification, we connect the kinetic properties of a protein’s conformational state to the change in state population from cooling. We show that cooling-induced population shifts are small but observable. We further introduce a thermodynamic-inference method to recover equilibrium populations from the cooled ensembles.

title: Selective profiling of translationally active tRNAs and their dynamics under stress
summary_zh: 开发tRIBO-seq方法，选择性分析翻译活跃的tRNA及其在压力下的动态变化。研究发现压力下ribo-tRNA显著改变。
summary_en: Develops tRIBO-seq method for selective profiling of translationally active tRNAs and their dynamics under stress. Finds that ribo-tRNAs are significantly altered under stress.
insights: 创新点：开发tRIBO-seq方法分析tRNA动态
方法亮点：使用tRIBO-seq分析翻译活跃的tRNA
关键发现：压力下ribo-tRNA显著改变
insights_en: Novelty: Develops tRIBO-seq method for tRNA dynamics analysis
Method highlight: Uses tRIBO-seq to analyze translationally active tRNAs
Key finding: Significant changes in ribo-tRNAs under stress
abstract: ABSTRACT During translation, transfer RNAs (tRNAs) deliver specific amino acids to the ribosome in a coordinated manner with the sequence encoded by the mRNA. Despite their central role in protein synthesis, their precise contribution to the modulation of translation remains poorly understood, primarily due to lack of methods to characterise tRNA abundances and their modifications from actively translating ribosomes. Here we develop tRIBO-seq, a simple and robust nanopore-based method to selectively capture ribosome-associated native tRNA populations (ribo-tRNAs) from actively translating ribosomes, providing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation information from a single experiment. Using tRIBO-seq, we find that ribo-tRNAs, but often not total tRNAs, are significantly altered upon stress. Notably, we find that tRNAome alterations strongly vary depending on the stress type: while viral infection and leucine deprivation leads to changes in ribo-tRNA abundances, methionine starvation causes a dramatic loss of methyl-based tRNA modifications. By contrast, we find that arsenite exposure does not alter tRNA abundances nor modification patterns, but rather causes major fragmentation events in selected subsets of ribo-tRNAs. Altogether, tRIBO-seq offers a robust and reproducible approach to map the full tRNA landscape –capturing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation patterns–, across both total and actively translating tRNA populations, revealing the dynamics of the tRNAome with unprecedented resolution, in a single experiment.

title: The limits of scaling in aggregation-driven patterning of cell collectives
summary_zh: 研究细胞聚集驱动图案化中缩放的限制。发现小系统允许快速、稳健的图案缩放，而大系统则延迟缩放。
summary_en: Studies the limits of scaling in aggregation-driven patterning of cell collectives. Finds that small systems allow rapid, robust pattern scaling, while large systems delay scaling.
insights: 创新点：研究细胞聚集驱动图案化中的缩放限制
方法亮点：结合细胞隔离、成像和化学扰动
关键发现：小系统快速缩放，大系统延迟缩放
insights_en: Novelty: Studies scaling limits in aggregation-driven cell patterning
Method highlight: Combines cell confinement, imaging, and chemical perturbations
Key finding: Small systems allow rapid scaling, large systems delay scaling
abstract: Abstract Robust development requires maintaining correct proportions as overall size varies. What controls and limits this scaling remains poorly understood due to the complex interplay of mechanical and biochemical embryonic factors. Combining confinement of dissociated embryonic presomitic mesoderm cells with imaging and chemical perturbations, we identified cell aggregation as the initial event in de novo posterior pole formation. Using a continuum model based solely on cell-cell attraction, we quantitatively map how the time available for aggregation-driven patterning limits the maximum scalable system size. Small systems allow rapid, robust pattern scaling, whereas coarsening dynamics substantially delay scaled patterns in large systems. Our experiments quantitatively confirm these predicted scaling regimes. Together, our results reveal a developmental time-size tradeoff governing the scaling of aggregation-driven patterns.

title: Heme signatures in mineralized red blood cells within vascular canals of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur bone
summary_zh: 在1.15亿年古恐龙骨骼血管通道中发现血红素特征。研究发现血红素B是主要四吡咯，支持内源性起源。
summary_en: Heme signatures found in mineralized red blood cells within vascular canals of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur bone. The study finds that heme B is the principal tetrapyrrole, supporting an endogenous origin.
insights: 创新点：在古恐龙骨骼中发现血红素特征
方法亮点：使用液相色谱-质谱联用和拉曼光谱分析
关键发现：血红素B支持内源性起源
insights_en: Novelty: Heme signatures found in ancient dinosaur bone
Method highlight: Uses HPLC-MS and Raman spectroscopy analysis
Key finding: Heme B supports an endogenous origin
abstract: Detection of endogenous biomolecules in vertebrate fossils remains controversial because labile compounds degrade quickly and are highly susceptible to contamination. Here, we present data on the preservation of heme-derived tetrapyrroles, and vascular canal-constrained ellipsoidal microstructures, inferred to be red blood cells, in limb bones of Aratasaurus museunacionali , a 115-million-year-old theropod dinosaur. High-performance liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry identified parent and diagenetically altered heme B as the principal tetrapyrroles of bone extract, contrasting the chlorophyll and bacteriochlorophyll porphyrin signatures of the surrounding matrix supporting an endogenous origin. Separate spatially resolved analyses by Raman spectroscopy and transmission electron microscopy confirmed the ellipsoid microstructure localization of i) porphyrin signals of heme and ii) key elements of heme (Fe, N, and C) and mineral stabilizing hausmannite (Mn 3 O 4 ), respectively. These results demonstrate blood-derived biomolecules in mineralized red blood cells of a dinosaur.

title: Fatty acid desaturation controls cellular fate decisions between senescence and ferroptosis
summary_zh: 研究细胞衰老和铁死亡决策。发现DGLA水平降低与细胞死亡相关。
summary_en: Studies cellular fate decisions between senescence and ferroptosis. Finds reduced DGLA levels associated with cell death.
insights: 创新点：DGLA与细胞命运关系
方法亮点：分析脂肪酸水平变化
关键发现：DGLA与铁死亡相关
insights_en: Novelty: DGLA and cellular fate relationship
Method highlight: Analysis of fatty acid levels
Key finding: DGLA associated with ferroptosis
abstract: Summary When subject to damage or stress, cells develop responses in order to maintain tissue homeostasis. Two such decisions are ferroptosis and cellular senescence, but how cells decide between these outcomes remains unclear. Here we show that senescent cells increase levels of multiple membrane-bound polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), but a specific PUFA, dihomo-gamma-linolenic acid (DGLA, 20:3 ω -3) is reduced. Exogenous repletion of DGLA or inhibition of delta-5-desaturase, the enzyme that metabolizes DGLA, instead results in cell death by ferroptosis. Senescent cells had elevated levels of other fezzroptosis sensitizers, including labile iron and expression of lipoxygenases – but also increased Gpx4 levels to prevent ferroptosis. Oral DGLA lowered senescent cell burden in aged mice and improved age-related functional outcomes. Finally, obese humans with lowered DGLA desaturation rates showed lower markers of adipose tissue senescence. Together, our data implicate DGLA and its desaturation as a major driver of decisions between senescence and ferroptosis.

title: Added Value of Preoperative Contrast Enhanced Mammography in Staging of Malignant Breast Lesions (PROCEM): A Randomized Controlled Trial
summary_zh: PROCEM试验评估术前对比增强乳腺摄影在乳腺癌分期中的附加价值。随机对照试验显示，CEM可显著改变治疗方案。
summary_en: The PROCEM trial assesses the added value of preoperative contrast-enhanced mammography in breast cancer staging. A randomized controlled trial shows that CEM can significantly alter treatment plans.
insights: CEM可显著改变治疗方案
随机对照试验证明CEM价值
术前CEM对乳腺癌分期有重要影响
insights_en: CEM can significantly alter treatment plans
Randomized controlled trial proves the value of CEM
Preoperative CEM has a significant impact on breast cancer staging
abstract: Background: Contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM) is increasingly used in breast cancer diagnostics. This is the first randomised trial assessing the additional value of CEM in preoperative staging of breast cancer.Method: This prospective randomised controlled trial, with two arms and a 1:1 allocation ratio, was performed at two hospitals in Sweden. In all, 440 patients with breast cancer, scheduled for primary surgery, were randomised to preoperative CEM or not (control). The primary outcome measure was a 10% treatment change due to CEM findings. Secondary outcome measures included the difference in reoperation/mastectomy rates between the randomisation arms, and estimation of malignant extent by CEM was compared with standard imaging (mammography/tomosynthesis and ultrasound) with histopathological extent as a reference, using Bland-Altman statistics and a concordance analysis. Subgroup analyses were made according to menopausal status, breast density and histopathological type of cancer. This trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, number NCT04437602.Findings: Inclusion was between November 2, 2020, and April 30, 2024. Four hundred and 15 participants completed the trial, 202 in the CEM group, and 213 in the control group. Treatment was changed for 17/202 participants (8·4%) due to CEM findings (95% CI: 5·32 – 13·06). No significant difference between the CEM and control group was seen for mastectomy or reoperation rate. Extent estimation was superior with CEM compared with mammography/tomosynthesis or ultrasound, overall and in the predefined subgroup analysis. Interpretation: The study did not meet its primary endpoint of 10% treatment change but suggests that preoperative CEM might be beneficial for improved extent estimation. Confidence in the method is essential to translate CEM findings into clinically relevant treatment changes.

title: Reconstructing the single-cell spatiotemporal dynamics of glioblastoma invasion
summary_zh: 引入GlioTrace框架，实时追踪胶质母细胞瘤侵袭。揭示侵袭可塑性、空间组织和治疗影响。
summary_en: Introduces the GlioTrace framework for real-time tracking of glioblastoma invasion. Reveals invasion plasticity, spatial organization, and therapeutic effects.
insights: 创新点：GlioTrace追踪侵袭动态
方法亮点：结合显微镜和机器学习
关键发现：侵袭可塑性和治疗影响
insights_en: Novelty: GlioTrace tracks invasion dynamics
Method highlight: Combining microscopy and machine learning
Key finding: Invasion plasticity and therapeutic effects
abstract: Glioblastoma invasion into healthy brain tissue remains a major barrier to effective treatment, but the dynamic single-cell behaviors underlying this process remain difficult to measure across patient models. Here, we introduce GlioTrace, an ex vivo imaging and computational framework for real-time tracking of glioblastoma invasion in patient-derived xenograft brain slices. Combining whole-specimen confocal microscopy with machine learning-based morphology classification and probabilistic modeling of state transitions, GlioTrace reconstructs how tumor cells switch between invasion phenotypes and how these dynamics are shaped by local tissue context and therapy. Across six patient-derived models, GlioTrace reveals that invasion plasticity is patient-specific, spatially organized, and modulated by vascular proximity and microglial interaction. Targeted therapies selectively alter phenotype composition and transition probabilities, whereas standard-of-care treatment enriches a highly motile, transition-connected branching state consistent with a treatment-tolerant invasive phenotype. Thus, GlioTrace makes glioblastoma invasion a measurable dynamic process for comparing patient-specific treatment responses in living brain tissue.

title: Limitations of de novo peptide sequencing in resolving sequence ambiguity
summary_zh: 评估了八种去卷积模型在蛋白质组学数据集中的性能，比较了识别准确性和模型间一致性。
summary_en: Evaluates the performance of eight de novo models in proteomics datasets, comparing identification accuracy and inter-model agreement.
insights: 创新点：比较了多种去卷积模型
方法亮点：基于蛋白质组学数据集的基准测试
关键发现：模型间存在性能差异
insights_en: Novelty: Compared multiple de novo models
Method highlight: Based on benchmark tests in proteomics datasets
Key finding: Performance differences exist among models
abstract: Abstract De novo peptide sequencing enables peptide identification from fragmentation spectra without relying on sequence databases. However, incomplete spectra create ambiguity, making unambiguous identification challenging. Recent deep learning advances have produced numerous de novo models that predict sequences and refine peptide-spectrum matches under such conditions. Yet, their relative strengths, weaknesses and ability to handle spectrum ambiguity remain unclear. Here we benchmark eight state-of-the-art models on three publicly available proteomics datasets, comparing performance using established metrics and quantifying inter-model agreement. We assess post-processing approaches, including iterative refinement, rescoring and reranking, for their ability to improve identification accuracy, and perform an error analysis to identify common mispredictions and their causes. Model performance varied, with considerable overlap of correct identifications. Post-processing yielded no or only modest improvements. Most sequencing errors were model-independent and driven by limited fragment ion coverage, a limitation also observed in database searches with large search spaces.

title: Extracellular polymeric substances drive Curvibacter host adaptation and cospeciation with Hydra
summary_zh: 研究Curvibacter与水螅的共生关系，发现共进化证据和分子适应机制。
summary_en: Studies the symbiotic relationship between Curvibacter and Hydra, finding evidence of co-evolution and molecular adaptation mechanisms.
insights: 创新点：发现共进化证据
方法亮点：结合系统学和分子生物学方法
关键发现：分子适应机制
insights_en: Novelty: Found evidence of co-evolution
Method highlight: Combined systematic and molecular biological methods
Key finding: Molecular adaptation mechanisms
abstract: Abstract The interactions between hosts and their microbial symbionts play a crucial role in shaping biological diversity and ecosystem function. Bacteria can adapt to specific host environments over evolutionary timescales, leading to co-speciation and the formation of specialized host-microbe relationships. Understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying these adaptations provides key insights into the evolution of symbiosis and the stability of microbial communities. This study investigates the co-speciation and molecular adaptations of Curvibacter to its host Hydra , a well-established model for the study of host-microbe interactions. We provide strong evidence of co-speciation, as demonstrated by phylogenetic congruence between different Hydra species and their corresponding Curvibacter symbionts, along with preferential recolonization of germ-free Hydra by their native Curvibacter strains. Comparative genomic analyses reveal that host-associated Curvibacter strains exhibit distinct metabolic and biosynthetic adaptations compared to their free-living relatives. Specifically, the enrichment of proteins involved in sugar metabolism and transport, as well as the selective purification of proteins linked to macromolecule biosynthesis, highlights the specialization of Curvibacter symbionts within the Hydra glycocalyx. Functional experiments identify a symbiont-specific extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) operon as key factor for microbial adhesion and host colonization, underscoring its role in facilitating symbiont specificity and stability. These findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms driving host-microbe co-evolution and highlight the evolutionary forces shaping microbial specialization within host-symbiont relationships. Significant Statement The vast majority of animal and plant species are associated with microbial organisms that offer a wide range of benefits for development, physiology, and health. Understanding the evolutionary forces that shape these symbiotic interactions is crucial for elucidating the mechanisms through which organisms mitigate environmental stress and enhance their resilience, particularly in response to rapidly changing environmental conditions. Using advanced bioinformatic, bioanalytical, and genetic approaches, this study demonstrates that Curvibacter symbionts have evolved specific extracellular polymeric substances to enhance their ability to form a specific symbiosis with Hydra .

title: iMED: A Multi-endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
summary_zh: 提出iMED数据集，用于解决手术视觉基准测试中的独立视角缺失问题。
summary_en: Introduces the iMED dataset to address the lack of independent viewpoints in surgical vision benchmarking.
insights: 创新点：提出新的手术视觉数据集
方法亮点：提供多视角同步数据
关键发现：解决视角缺失问题
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a new surgical vision dataset
Method highlight: Provides multi-view synchronized data
Key finding: Resolves the issue of missing viewpoints
abstract: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.

title: 3D confinement reshapes RNA folding and enhances circularization in the Zika virus
summary_zh: 研究RNA在受限环境中的折叠。开发模型模拟RNA结构。发现病毒基因组在受限环境中折叠不同。
summary_en: Studies RNA folding in confined environments. Develops a model to simulate RNA structures. Finds the virus genome folds differently in confined environments.
insights: 创新点：开发模型模拟RNA结构
方法亮点：研究RNA在受限环境中的折叠
关键发现：病毒基因组在受限环境中折叠不同
insights_en: Novelty: Developing a model to simulate RNA structures
Method highlight: Studying RNA folding in confined environments
Key finding: The virus genome folds differently in confined environments
abstract: Abstract Many RNA molecules function within confined environments, but the effect of confinement on RNA folding remains poorly understood. Proximity ligation experiments reveal altered long-range contacts in confined versus unconfined states, yet they do not explain how spatial constraints give rise to these differences. Here, we develop a physical modeling approach that incorporates proximity ligation data into coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations to reconstruct RNA 3D structures under confinement. We test our model on the ∼ 11 kb genome of the Zika virus, comparing the folding in virions (confined) and in cells (unconfined). We observe that the probability of contact between two regions of the genome vs. linear distance follows different scaling laws in the confined and unconfined cases, in agreement with proximity ligation experiments. We find that genome circularization – an interaction that regulates replication in Zika – occurs more frequently under confinement in both experiments and simulations. Our model reveals that the formation of long double-stranded stems through stacking confers local nematic liquid crystalline order to the RNA, and predicts pseudoknot topologies consistent with those seen in crystallographic structures of shorter RNAs. These results provide insight into the mechanism through which confinement alters the ensemble of 3D structures accessible to a long RNA molecule. Significance statement Squeezing a polymer into a tight ball changes how it behaves: distant segments are forced into close contact, making ends more likely to meet. Similar principles apply to biopolymers, such as RNA, when confined within virus particles or other enclosures smaller than the polymer contour length, but there is no framework to model the effects of confinement on RNA folding. Here we develop such a framework, combining molecular dynamics simulations with experimental measurements of contacts within unconfined and confined RNA molecules. We find that RNA is glassy and exhibits liquid crystalline order, and that genome circularization, a long-range interaction between the two ends of the viral RNA important for virus replication, is facilitated under confinement.

title: Nonadiabatic dynamics of the ferroelectric soft mode
summary_zh: 研究铁电软模的非绝热动力学。使用时间分辨技术跟踪极化和晶格运动。发现极化动力学非线性。
summary_en: Studies the nonadiabatic dynamics of the ferroelectric soft mode. Uses time-resolved techniques to track polarization and coherent lattice motion. Finds non-linear polarization dynamics.
insights: 创新点：研究铁电软模的非绝热动力学
方法亮点：使用时间分辨技术
关键发现：极化动力学非线性
insights_en: Novelty: Studying the nonadiabatic dynamics of the ferroelectric soft mode
Method highlight: Using time-resolved techniques
Key finding: Non-linear polarization dynamics
abstract: Most microscopic descriptions of structural dynamics assume the Born–Oppenheimer separation, where electrons adjust adiabatically to ionic motion. When this separation breaks down, electronic and lattice degrees of freedom can evolve on different timescales, giving rise to new physical phenomena beyond the adiabatic limit. Here, we use time-resolved, phase-sensitive second-harmonic generation and pump–probe reflectivity to reshape the ferroelectric free-energy landscape of SnTe while separately tracking polar order and coherent lattice motion. When photoexcitation transiently suppresses the double-well barrier, polarization dynamics become strongly nonlinear, while the coherent phonon dynamics remain harmonic. This decoupling cannot be described by a single adiabatic coordinate for the electronic polarization and ionic positions. We provide a unifying physical description for the nonadiabatic dynamics of the ferroelectric mode and the mixed displacive/order–disorder nature of SnTe based on a separation of scales for the renormalization of the ferroelectric stiffness.

title: TLR7-independent control of retroviral infection
summary_zh: 发现TLR7非依赖性控制逆转录病毒感染。揭示新的免疫激活途径。研究小鼠白血病病毒感染。
summary_en: Discoveries TLR7-independent control of retroviral infection. Reveals a new immune activation pathway. Studies murine leukemia virus infection.
insights: 创新点：发现TLR7非依赖性控制逆转录病毒感染
方法亮点：研究小鼠白血病病毒感染
关键发现：揭示新的免疫激活途径
insights_en: Novelty: Discovering TLR7-independent control of retroviral infection
Method highlight: Studying murine leukemia virus infection
Key finding: Revealing a new immune activation pathway
abstract: ABSTRACT Development of effective immune responses against any pathogen requires efficient activation of the innate immune system followed by induction of an appropriate adaptive immune response using specific signaling pathways tailored to each infection. The sole innate immune receptor implicated in the induction of adaptive immunity to retroviral infection is Toll like receptor 7 (TLR7). We have found that germinal center responses, neutralizing antibody production, and clearance of murine leukemia virus (MLV) infection in BALB.J and C57BL/6N (B6N) mice occurs in the absence of TLR7 signaling. This suggests that a previously unknown alternative sensing pathway exists for the activation of protective immune responses upon retroviral infection. Genetic crosses indicate that the ability to control retroviral infection in the absence of TLR7 signaling is determined by the same recessive mechanism in both B6N and BALB.J mice, suggesting that TLR7-independent responses do not result from a gain-of-function of an alternative pattern recognition receptor. Additionally, we observed that TLR7-deficient BALB.J mice produce neutralizing antibodies against mouse mammary tumor virus (MMTV) infection, indicating that this alternative sensing pathway is active against retroviruses of multiple genera. Finally, we determined that the alternative sensing pathway is also independent of both MyD88 and STING signaling. The ability of mice of two genetic backgrounds to control retroviral infection in the absence of TLR7 signaling provides a valuable tool for the identification of a novel mechanism of retrovirus control. The dissection of this pathway has the potential to alter our understanding of the requirements for the stimulation of antigen-specific neutralizing immunity. Significance Statement Innate immune sensors are required for induction of pathogen-specific immune responses, and the development of novel vaccines requires an understanding of the basic mechanisms by which the immune system detects and responds to pathogens. While multiple innate immune receptors have been implicated in the sensing of retroviral infection, only Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) has been found to upregulate adaptive immune responses. Here, we demonstrate that an additional TLR7-independent mechanism for the activation of antiretroviral antibody responses is present in inbred mice from two genetic backgrounds. This finding has implications for the selection of mouse models for the study of antiviral immune responses and has the potential to alter our understanding of the requirements for the stimulation of antigen-specific neutralizing immunity.

title: Molecular basis of quorum-sensing signal transduction by CqsS and its inhibition by CqsA, the autoinducer synthase
summary_zh: 研究CqsS的群体感应信号转导。确定CqsS的冷冻电镜结构。揭示CqsS磷酸化级联的分子基础。
summary_en: Studies the quorum-sensing signal transduction by CqsS. Determines the cryo-EM structures of CqsS. Reveals the molecular basis for the CqsS phosphorylation cascade.
insights: 创新点：研究CqsS的群体感应信号转导
方法亮点：确定CqsS的冷冻电镜结构
关键发现：揭示CqsS磷酸化级联的分子基础
insights_en: Novelty: Studying the quorum-sensing signal transduction by CqsS
Method highlight: Determining the cryo-EM structures of CqsS
Key finding: Revealing the molecular basis for the CqsS phosphorylation cascade
abstract: Abstract Vibrio bacteria possess multiple quorum-sensing systems, each of which conveys information into the cell concerning the cell density and species composition of the vicinal community. Germane to the present work is the CqsA-CqsS quorum-sensing pathway that vibrios use for intra-genus communication. CqsA is the synthase for the autoinducer ( S )-3-hydroxytridecan-4-one (CAI-1), and CqsS, a bi-functional two-component kinase-phosphatase, is the CAI-1 receptor. Here, we determine the cryo-EM structures of the full-length Vibrio harveyi CqsS dimer in the apo- and ATPγS-bound states. Our structures reveal the molecular basis for the initiation of the phosphorylation cascade, which we support through biochemical and genetic analyses. Autophosphorylation of CqsS occurs in cis at the conserved histidine residue (H1), whereas phospho-transfer to the conserved aspartate residue (D1) in the C-terminal receiver domain occurs in trans . By co-expressing CqsS and CqsA to capture CqsS bound to CAI-1, we unexpectedly discover a tight interaction between the CqsS intracellular domain and CqsA. In the complex, the CqsS H1 residues are positioned away from the catalytic cavity, and CqsS kinase activity is inhibited. Cryo-EM analysis, focused on the transmembrane domain of CqsS in this complex, reveals the presence of two CAI-1 molecules. CAI-1 binding induces an obvious movement of transmembrane helix 6, disrupting its extension into the cytosol, providing a structural basis for how CAI-1 binding in the periplasm is coupled to signal transduction into the cytoplasm. Together, our findings advance the understanding of CqsS-CAI-1-mediated quorum-sensing signal transduction, an activity that underpins the coordination of group behaviors in vibrios.

title: A causal account of the neural origins of mental fatigue
summary_zh: 研究认知控制与疲劳关系，结合脑刺激与光谱成像。发现DLPFC激活与疲劳相关。
summary_en: Investigates the relationship between cognitive control and fatigue, combining brain stimulation with spectroscopy imaging. Finds DLPFC activation associated with fatigue.
insights: 认知控制与疲劳相关
DLPFC激活与疲劳相关
脑刺激与光谱成像结合
insights_en: Cognitive control is related to fatigue
DLPFC activation is related to fatigue
Combination of brain stimulation and spectroscopy imaging
abstract: Successful goal-directed behavior often requires the exertion of effortful cognitive control processes, but it remains unclear why engaging in cognitive control is experienced as effortful and induces fatigue. Here, we tested the hypothesis that sustained activation in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC)—a neural substrate of cognitive control—causally induces motivational fatigue via the accumulation of prefrontal glutamate metabolites. For this purpose, we combined brain stimulation with spectroscopy imaging to assess how increasing DLPFC excitability during an effortful mental task changes the motivation for mental effort and glutamate concentrations. We found that stimulating the DLPFC during mental effort exertion improved mental performance at the cost of increased posteffort motivational fatigue, suggesting a causal role of DLPFC activation for inducing fatigue. On the neural level, DLPFC activation during effortful cognition also increased prefrontal concentrations of glutamate, which statistically explained the fatigue-induced lower motivation for mental effort. A corresponding analysis of combined glutamate–glutamine (Glx) concentrations revealed converging effects. Together, these findings provide causal evidence that enhanced DLPFC activation contributes to fatigue via neurochemical changes, supporting neuro-metabolic accounts of fatigue and offering new insights into why demanding cognitive tasks are perceived as effortful.

title: Rapid soil degradation of a cross-linked, semicrystalline polyethylene-like polyester produced by Colletes bees
summary_zh: 研究Colletes蜜蜂巢穴中PE类似聚酯的快速生物降解性。聚酯在高温下不溶于三氯苯或甲苯。
summary_en: Studies the rapid biodegradability of a PE-like polyester produced by Colletes bees in their nests. The polyester is insoluble in trichlorobenzene or toluene at elevated temperatures.
insights: PE类似聚酯快速生物降解
聚酯不溶于三氯苯或甲苯
Colletes蜜蜂巢穴聚酯特性
insights_en: Rapid biodegradability of PE-like polyester
Insolubility of polyester in trichlorobenzene or toluene
Characteristics of polyester in Colletes bee nests
abstract: Polyethylene (PE)-like polyesters have long been investigated as biodegradable alternatives to conventional polyolefins but degrade poorly despite possessing hydrolyzable esters due to high crystallinity and hydrophobicity. Bees of the genus Colletes line their nests with a PE-like polyester that shows no environmental accumulation despite decades of nesting in dense aggregations, suggesting rapid biodegradability. This work provides a comprehensive characterization of Colletes inaequalis polyester and demonstrates its rapid degradation under ambient environmental conditions. Colletes polyester is completely insoluble in trichlorobenzene or toluene at elevated temperatures, indicating cross-linking despite originating from macrocyclic lactones that lack obvious cross-linkable functionality. Small molecules extracted from the network match the Dufour’s gland secretion but lack macrolactone, indicating complete monomer conversion. Although its repeat unit resembles amorphous, network-like plant cutin, Colletes polyester is highly crystalline ( X c = 60%), with PE-like orthorhombic packing and T m = 75 °C, indicating a much lower cross-link density. Composition analysis of nest linings collected 0 to 11 mo after construction reveals significant degradation, with polyester content falling from 73 to 40 wt% within 4 mo in ambient soil. Esterase activity against the model substrate p-nitrophenylbutyrate is observed in both newly constructed and 4-mo aged linings, which may accelerate environmental degradation. Crystallites also lack higher-order spherulitic or lamellar structure, possibly due to cross-linking, which may promote degradation by leaving more esters exposed to cleavage. This PE-like polyester is shown to degrade rapidly in the environment, offering a template for next-generation biodegradable PE-like polymers.

title: Thermal ecology drives alternate responses to rising temperatures in Caribbean anoles
summary_zh: 研究加勒比蜥蜴对温度上升的适应性响应。发现热生态学原理可预测生物对温度上升的响应。
summary_en: Studies adaptive responses of Caribbean anoles to rising temperatures. Finds that principles of thermal ecology can predict organismal responses to warming.
insights: 热生态学预测温度上升响应
蜥蜴对温度上升的适应性响应
热生态学原理应用
insights_en: Thermal ecology predicts responses to warming
Adaptive responses of anoles to rising temperatures
Application of thermal ecology principles
abstract: Rapidly rising temperatures threaten populations of ectothermic animals worldwide, with the greatest impacts predicted in the tropics—hotspots for biodiversity. Ectotherms can respond to warming through two primary compensatory responses: behavioral thermoregulation, which buffers exposure to extreme temperatures; and heat tolerance increases via plasticity, adaptation, or both. The relative contribution of these responses is predicted to depend on ecological context, but whether these principles can anticipate organismal responses to contemporary warming remains largely untested. Here, using a decadal resurvey of anole lizards from Hispaniola, Jamaica, and Puerto Rico, we show that simple principles of thermal ecology can reliably anticipate organismal responses to rising temperatures. Species occupying thermally heterogeneous open/edge habitats, such as dry forests, behaviorally thermoregulate and have shown little to no increase in heat tolerance over the past decade. By contrast, species from thermally homogeneous closed-canopy environments are poor thermoregulators and have increased their heat tolerance by 2 °C, on average, over the same period. Seasonal comparisons, acclimation experiments, and laboratory-rearing experiments indicate that contemporary increases in heat tolerance likely reflect contributions from rapid evolutionary change and physiological plasticity. Thermal ecology, not phylogenetic or spatial proximity, is the key factor driving responses to rising temperatures. Our results consistently link organismal responses to habitat complexity and thermoregulatory behavior; we suggest that these factors are key to predicting how ectotherms respond to climate warming.

title: CD8 + regulatory T cells limit immunopathology but impair viral clearance in Hantaan virus infection
summary_zh: 研究汉坦病毒感染中CD8+调节T细胞的作用。发现CD8+调节T细胞限制免疫病理但损害病毒清除。
summary_en: Studies the role of CD8+ regulatory T cells in Hantaan virus infection. Finds that CD8+ regulatory T cells limit immunopathology but impair viral clearance.
insights: CD8+调节T细胞限制免疫病理
损害病毒清除
汉坦病毒感染中的CD8+调节T细胞作用
insights_en: CD8+ regulatory T cells limit immunopathology
Impairment of viral clearance
Role of CD8+ regulatory T cells in Hantaan virus infection
abstract: In hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) caused by Hantaan virus (HTNV), virus-specific CD8 + T cells mediate both viral clearance and immunopathology. Here, we characterized a CD8 + regulatory T cell (Treg) subset restricted by HLA-E (and its murine ortholog Qa-1) in HFRS patients and in a murine HTNV infection model. CD8 + Tregs (CD122 + Eomes + CD49d lo KIR + ), a subset substantially enriched for HLA-E-restricted T cells, were significantly reduced in peripheral blood of HFRS patients and displayed a terminally differentiated profile with elevated expression of KLRG-1, NKG2A, CTLA-4, and Fas-L, correlating with disease severity. Two HTNV glycoprotein-derived nonapeptides that bound Qa-1 were identified. Following immunization with the identified HTNV peptides and subsequent HTNV challenge, wild-type (WT) mice showed attenuated renal immunopathology, whereas D227K knock-in mice (with disrupted Qa-1-CD8/TCR interaction) showed enhanced viral clearance in the spleen and kidney but exacerbated renal immunopathology. Mechanistically, Qa-1-restricted CD8 + Tregs from WT mice suppressed effector CD8 + T cell proliferation in a peptide-specific, CD8/TCR-dependent manner via enhanced TGF-β secretion. Strikingly, D227K mutation dichotomously reshaped Treg phenotype: bulk polyclonal CD8 + Tregs displayed compensatory upregulation of inhibitory receptors (NKG2A, CTLA-4, PD-1) and TGF-β, whereas epitope-specific CD8 + Tregs showed impaired antigen-specific suppressive function and attenuated TGF-β production. Collectively, these findings indicate that HLA-E/Qa-1-restricted CD8 + Tregs can restrain immunopathology during HTNV infection, potentially at the cost of delayed viral elimination. Modulation of this axis may provide insights for therapeutic strategies in HFRS and related viral hemorrhagic fevers.

title: Environmental forcing, individual repeatability, and mother–daughter resemblance shape the phenology of a long-lived seabird
summary_zh: 研究长寿海鸟繁殖节律受环境因素影响。发现环境因素与个体重复性塑造繁殖节律。
summary_en: Studies the influence of environmental factors on the breeding phenology of a long-lived seabird. Finds that environmental factors and individual repeatability shape breeding phenology.
insights: 环境因素塑造繁殖节律
个体重复性影响繁殖节律
长寿海鸟繁殖节律研究
insights_en: Environmental factors shape breeding phenology
Individual repeatability affects breeding phenology
Research on breeding phenology of long-lived seabirds
abstract: Climate change and variability push species to shift their distributions and phenology to track their climatic niche. Predicting population responses requires identifying the environmental cues that trigger reproduction, their fitness consequences, and the intrinsic factors that shape individual breeding decisions. In long-lived species with deferred breeding, extrinsic (environmental) and intrinsic (individual/maternal) factors may interact in shaping responses to environmental change, but direct empirical evidence remains scarce. We use 2065 breeding events collected over 22 y on a wide-ranging seabird, the Scopoli’s Shearwater. We quantify the effects on population mean laying date of a large-scale climatic index (wNAO) associated with oceanographic conditions. We assess how individual breeding experience and mother–daughter resemblance contribute to among-female differences in reproductive timing, and evaluate the consequences for breeding success (BS) and adult survival. Average laying date was earlier under negative phases of wNAO, indicating a plastic response at the population level. Individual repeatability in the relative laying date (RLD) was high ( R = 0.50) irrespective of experience, indicating consistency among females. Using 142 mother–daughter cases, daughters’ RLD resembled those of their mothers, a covariance that may reflect genetic inheritance, maternal effects, or shared environment. Early laying was associated with higher BS and survival, translating into an annual fitness advantage. Differences in survival and BS across individuals were more evident during the first observed breeding attempts. Together, these results support a scenario in which plasticity shifts the population mean breeding date in response to climatic variation, while persistent traits generate differential fitness among individuals.

title: Kinome profiling enabled development of a LATS1/2 inhibitor with wound healing potential
summary_zh: 研究通过激酶组分析发现LATS1/2抑制剂。抑制剂具有促进伤口愈合的潜力。
summary_en: Develops a LATS1/2 inhibitor through kinome profiling with potential for wound healing.
insights: 激酶组分析发现抑制剂
LATS1/2抑制剂促进伤口愈合
药物研发新途径
insights_en: Inhibitor discovery through kinome profiling
LATS1/2 inhibitor promotes wound healing
New approach to drug development
abstract: System-level mapping of kinase inhibitors’ polypharmacology can uncover opportunities for drug repurposing and identify starting points for medicinal chemistry campaigns aimed at novel targets. Here, we describe a large-scale profiling of 257 kinase inhibitors that revealed domains of promiscuity, a broad region of uninhibited targets and discrete pockets of selectivity. Focusing on a subcluster enriched for AGC group kinases and using the AKT inhibitor AT-7867 (an antiproliferative agent) as a starting point, we employed scaffold hopping and property-based optimization to discover NCGC-6782, a LATS1/2 inhibitor with robust proproliferative activity. In biochemical and cell-based assays, NCGC-6782 inhibited LATS1/2 activity, reduced YAP phosphorylation, and promoted rapid YAP nuclear translocation and transactivation of YAP-target genes. Kinome-wide profilings demonstrated good in vitro selectivity and exquisite chemoproteomic and kinetic selectivity. In vivo, NCGC-6782 exhibited favorable pharmacokinetic (PK) profiles following intraperitoneal (IP), intravenous (IV), or oral (PO) dosing, leading to rapid inhibition of YAP-phosphorylation in murine liver samples. Transcriptomics and proteomics following NCGC-6782 revealed upregulation of YAP-dependent genes (4 h) followed by activation of cell cycle programs (24 h). Consistently, NCGC-6782 accelerated proliferative regeneration in both cell-based and in vivo wound healing models of full-thickness excisional skin injury, significantly shortening wound-closure time without evidence of systemic toxicity. Altogether, we describe an optimized, potent, and selective LATS1/2 kinase inhibitor with desirable drug-like properties and broad potential for regenerative medicine applications following acute injury of nonproliferative, postmitotic tissues.

title: Using high-frequency data to quantify how urban nature affects air temperature and energy consumption
summary_zh: 研究城市自然如何影响空气温度和能源消耗。发现城市自然有助于城市降温，减少能源消耗。
summary_en: Studies how urban nature affects air temperature and energy consumption. Finds that urban nature contributes to urban cooling and reduces energy consumption.
insights: 城市自然影响空气温度和能源消耗
城市自然有助于城市降温
城市自然与能源消耗关系
insights_en: Urban nature affects air temperature and energy consumption
Urban nature contributes to urban cooling
Relationship between urban nature and energy consumption
abstract: Globally, cities account for 78% of energy consumption and 70~75% of greenhouse gas emissions. Using spatially explicit data on urban vegetation, water bodies, and buildings, combined with extensive daily observations of air temperature and electricity consumption for the subtropical megacity of Shenzhen, China, this study shows that urban nature contributes to urban cooling, reducing energy consumption and associated greenhouse gas emissions. We found that green and blue spaces in the city’s built-up area had a pronounced influence on air temperature, ranging from a cooling effect of 1.27 °C to a warming effect of 0.29 °C, with the cooling effect being dominant over the course of a year. The cooling effect was greatest at moderate temperatures (~20 °C) and was lower on hotter days. We identified a temperature threshold of 16 to 18 °C above which urban nature produces measurable reductions in cooling energy demand. We found that residential electricity consumption was more temperature-sensitive than nonresidential electricity consumption. For the study year of 2021, the net electricity savings from urban nature was 1.5 billion kWh. This reduction in energy consumption translated to almost one million tons of avoided CO 2 emissions, which was 4.65-times the sequestration capacity of the city’s terrestrial vegetation and equivalent to the annual emissions of over 223 thousand people using global average annual per capita carbon emissions.

title: Pericyte contraction generates angiostatic effect via cell force–dependent activation of TGFβ
summary_zh: 研究血管周细胞收缩通过TGFβ激活产生抗血管生成效应。发现细胞力依赖性TGFβ激活。
summary_en: Studies pericyte contraction generating an angiostatic effect via cell force-dependent TGFβ activation. Finds cell force-dependent TGFβ activation.
insights: 血管周细胞收缩产生抗血管生成效应
细胞力依赖性TGFβ激活
TGFβ激活机制研究
insights_en: Pericyte contraction generates angiostatic effect
Cell force-dependent TGFβ activation
TGFβ activation mechanism study
abstract: Pericytes are phenotypically plastic and capable of switching between contractile and proliferative phenotypes, similar to vascular smooth muscle cells. The intimate interaction of contractile pericytes with endothelial cells (ECs) is essential to the maturation, quiescence, and stability of the capillary and microvascular endothelium. However, the mechanistic link between pericyte contraction and vascular stability is unknown. It is known that TGFβ has dual pro- and antiangiogenic effects depending on the downstream Smad signaling. Here, we show that R-Ras-mediated contractility in pericytes activates TGFβ by integrin-dependent, actomyosin-generated cell traction force. This TGFβ activation, in turn, promotes the quiescence of ECs via the ALK5-Smad2/3 axis of the TGFβ pathway in ECs, but not the Smad1/5 axis of the TGFβ pathway. Furthermore, pericyte-targeted deletion of Rras in mice resulted in impaired pericyte contractility and a significant reduction of Smad2/3 phosphorylation in ECs, accompanied by increased tumor angiogenesis and vessel deformation in the skeletal muscle. These observations suggest that pericytes use the cell force to maintain the quiescence of the endothelium by elevating the local bioavailability of active TGFβ. Our findings provide a mechanism by which pericytes stabilize blood vessels.

title: Correction for Tsang et al., Cyclin D1 overexpression supports stable EBV infection in nasopharyngeal epithelial cells
Correction for Borowiec et al., Mutations at the BLK locus linked to maturity onset diabetes of the young and β-cell dysfunction
Lifetime stressor exposure is associated with altered trust formation and social learning in dynamic interactions

summary_en: This study assesses the relationship between lifetime stress exposure and trust formation. Using trust games and computational models, the results show a correlation between stress and trust dynamics.

关键发现：压力与信任动态变化相关
insights_en: Novelty: First linking lifetime stress exposure to trust formation
Method highlight: Combining trust games with computational models
Key finding: Correlation between stress and trust dynamics
abstract: Although trust is fundamental to social interactions, how lifetime stressor exposure relates to the cognitive processes underlying trust remains poorly understood. Using the Stress and Adversity Inventory (STRAIN) to assess cumulative lifetime stressor exposure, combined with an adaptation of the repeated trust game and computational modeling (Hierarchical Gaussian Filtering), we investigated how stressors experienced over the life course relate to three core aspects of trust dynamics—initial trust formation, learning about others’ intentions, and adaptation to changes in trustworthiness—in 168 adults. Greater lifetime stress was associated with stronger negativity biases, lower initial trust, and heightened uncertainty about others’ intentions, increases that were general rather than specific to partner type. These more pessimistic priors were not accompanied by poorer reading of partners: Higher lifetime stress was associated with greater differentiation between prosocial and selfish trustees, driven by reduced investment in the selfish trustee alone. Computational analyses further indicated greater belief volatility, consistent with faster model-implied updating of perceived trustworthiness. These findings provide novel evidence that lifetime stress is associated with a profile consistent with recalibration, rather than a degradation, of the cognitive mechanisms underlying trust, with potential consequences for relationship formation and social functioning. They also provide a computationally grounded framework for understanding associations between adversity and social cognition and generate testable predictions for future experimental work.

title: On-site, subannual climate records decouple Neolithic expansion from climate instability
summary_zh: 研究通过考古遗址气候信息揭示新石器时代扩张与气候不稳定的关系。发现极端事件影响有限。
summary_en: This study reveals the relationship between Neolithic expansion and climate instability using on-site climate records from archaeological sites. Finds that extreme events had limited impact.
insights: 创新点：利用考古遗址气候信息研究古代气候变化
方法亮点：结合考古学与气候学方法
关键发现：极端事件对人类决策影响有限
insights_en: Novelty: Using archaeological climate information to study ancient climate change
Method highlight: Combining archaeology and climatology methods
Key finding: Limited impact of extreme events on human decision-making
abstract: How the life of prehistoric people was influenced by climate change and extreme events often remains elusive. Finding appropriate spatiotemporal scales is the major challenge for studies with socioenvironmental questions. This challenge can be overcome by sourcing climatic information from archaeological sites, alongside traces of human agency. For instance, extreme cold-events have been proposed as causing a standstill in early farming expansion across the Mediterranean 8600-8000 years ago. However, there is no immediate (local/short-term) evidence of such events and how they might have influenced people’s lives, nor have previous records been sufficiently resolved to test this robustly. Here we statistically assess the influence of on-site and short-term extremes on human decision-making hypothesized by long-term climate records. Using the largest dataset yet of high-resolution temperature archives in mollusks, we test whether early farmers would have been exposed to extreme cold-events, compromising their subsistence by reducing harvest yields. This immediate agricultural risk is argued to have prevented the spread of new settlements and thus delayed the vigorous expansion that followed, one of prehistory’s fastest known dispersals. Direct comparison of paleotemperature and subsistence data from the same archaeological contexts shows no winter cooling of the magnitude proposed for this period, and no strong relationship between climate and subsistence. Our study reveals how a major scale mismatch in climate-society research can be resolved at the site level, integrating climatic variability on the subannual timescale crucial to farming, and provides a direct, local empirical test of a long-assumed climate impact.

title: Binding sites as dynamic hubs of coevolution encoded information flow
summary_zh: 研究提出一种框架，将共进化信息与高斯网络模型结合。发现结合位点为信息传递动态中心。
summary_en: This study introduces a framework integrating coevolutionary information with Gaussian Network Model. Finds that binding sites are dynamic hubs for information transfer.
insights: 创新点：提出结合共进化信息与高斯网络模型的新框架
方法亮点：利用序列信息分析结合位点
关键发现：结合位点为信息传递动态中心
insights_en: Novelty: Introducing a new framework that integrates coevolutionary information with Gaussian Network Model
Method highlight: Using sequence information to analyze binding sites
Key finding: Binding sites as dynamic hubs for information transfer
abstract: The relationship between evolution and allostery is inherently intertwined. While structural studies have elucidated allosteric mechanisms, the extent to which evolutionary sequence information encodes these dynamic networks remains underexplored. Here, we introduce Sequence-based GNM-TE, a framework that integrates coevolutionary information with Gaussian Network Model (GNM) based Transfer Entropy (TE) calculations. This approach translates evolutionary constraints, shaped by both structural and functional requirements, into functionally meaningful allosteric dynamic information. Across 29 cases, we identify binding sites as dynamic hubs of collective information transfer and reveal mode-dependent, directional information flows between these sites. These findings overall indicate that evolutionary constraints embed the architecture of allosteric regulation within protein sequences, preserving binding site communication within layered dynamic ensembles that enable robust functional control and adaptation.

title: Correction for Iwawaki et al., Function of IRE1 alpha in the placenta is essential for placental development and embryonic viability
Afforestation reshapes wildfire activity across global temperate biomes
summary_zh: 研究量化了植树造林对全球温带生物群落火灾活动的影响。发现植树造林增加了火灾发生和燃烧面积。
summary_en: This study quantifies the impact of afforestation on wildfire activity across global temperate biomes. Finds that afforestation increases fire occurrence and burned area.
insights: 创新点：量化植树造林对火灾活动的影响
方法亮点：结合土地利用变化和气候数据
关键发现：植树造林增加火灾发生和燃烧面积
insights_en: Novelty: Quantifying the impact of afforestation on wildfire activity
Method highlight: Combining land-use change and climatic data
Key finding: Afforestation increases fire occurrence and burned area
abstract: In temperate ecosystems, afforestation is rapidly expanding as a flagship climate mitigation strategy. Yet its impact on wildfires remains poorly understood, raising concerns that establishing planted forests over nonforest areas may intensify wildfire activity under increasingly fire-prone climatic conditions. Here, we combine land-use change data, fire activity records, climatic and anthropogenic covariates to quantify how afforestation alters fire occurrence and burned area across 67,248 patches distributed throughout global temperate biomes using satellite records starting in 2001. We found that, on average, afforestation increased fire occurrence by 26% and burned area by 23% in global temperate regions. However, these effects differed markedly among biomes. Wildfire responses ranged from a near-threefold increase in fire occurrence in Temperate Conifer Forests and a 38% increase in Mediterranean Woodlands biomes to an 18% reduction in the Temperate Grasslands, Savannas, and Shrublands biome. In Temperate Broadleaf and Mixed Forests, afforestation reduced fire occurrence but increased burned area, indicating a shift toward less frequent but larger wildfires following the conversion to planted forest. These contrasting, biome-specific responses show that the consequences of afforestation on wildfire activity may depend strongly on ecological and regional context. The strong variability at biome-scale questions the premise that tree planting provides consistent climate mitigation benefits across all landscapes, and highlights the need to evaluate afforestation initiatives alongside regional disturbance regimes. Our findings indicate that wildfire risk should be explicitly accounted for when assessing the long-term effectiveness of afforestation as a climate mitigation strategy in a warming world.

title: Ancient genomes from Mendoza, Argentina, trace the dynamics of colonial urban formation in the Southern Cone of the Americas
summary_zh: 研究通过古基因组分析追踪阿根廷门多萨殖民城市形成动态。揭示殖民社会形成过程。
summary_en: This study traces the dynamics of colonial urban formation in Mendoza, Argentina, through ancient genome analysis. Reveals the process of colonial society formation.
insights: 创新点：利用古基因组分析殖民社会形成
方法亮点：结合考古学与遗传学方法
关键发现：揭示殖民社会形成过程
insights_en: Novelty: Using ancient genome analysis to study colonial society formation
Method highlight: Combining archaeology and genetics methods
Key finding: Revealing the process of colonial society formation
abstract: European colonization introduced abrupt changes into the Americas. These included the introduction of infectious diseases, forced labor and displacement of Indigenous and African individuals, European settlement, and the imposition of caste regimes. However, the role of these forces in reshaping communities across different regions remains debated. This is especially true in the Virreinato del Río de la Plata (the territories of present-day Argentina, Bolivia, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Brazil), which is less studied than other regions such as the United States, the Caribbean, and Mexico. We investigated how these forces shaped the colonial societies of Mendoza in the Cuyo region (Central-Western Argentina) by sequencing ancient DNA of 28 individuals (17th to 19th centuries) excavated from churches associated with different social strata, recovering 22 mitochondrial genomes, and genome-wide data of 15 individuals. By performing paleogenomic analyses contextualized by burial site, we detected admixture among Indigenous, European, and African populations, with ancestry partially structured by church and burial location. Exceptions to this pattern indicate social mobility and flexible social classifications beyond genetic ancestry. The European-related ancestry aligns with Southern European migration, while African-related ancestry shows affinities to Western-Central Africa. The Indigenous-related ancestry shows highest affinity to precontact populations from Cuyo, supporting local genetic continuity across the colonial period. Additionally, uniparental markers reflect sex-biased dispersal and admixture. These findings reveal often-neglected African contributions to the city’s formation and illustrate how caste, labor, and migration shaped colonial urban societies. Our work provides a scalable model for interrogating caste regimes, social mobility, and admixture in understudied regions of the Americas.

title: Designing school choice for diversity in the San Francisco Unified School District
summary_zh: 研究设计学生分配政策以实现多样性。采用优化技术限制选择区域。
summary_en: This study designs a student assignment policy to achieve diversity. Uses optimization techniques to restrict choice to zones.
insights: 创新点：设计学生分配政策以促进多样性
方法亮点：采用优化技术限制选择区域
关键发现：政策可减少学校隔离
insights_en: Novelty: Designing student assignment policies to promote diversity
Method highlight: Using optimization techniques to restrict choice to zones
Key finding: Policies can reduce school segregation
abstract: More than 65 years after the Brown v. Board of Education ruling that school segregation is unconstitutional, public schools across the United States are again experiencing rising segregation. In districts like San Francisco, efforts to implement district-wide choice policies have largely failed to reverse these trends. Since 2019, we have collaborated with the San Francisco Unified School District to design a student assignment policy meeting the district’s goals of diversity, predictability, and proximity. We use optimization techniques to develop policies restricting choice to zones. We compare these to district-wide choice policies by estimating a choice model using historical application data and simulating assignment. Our results show multiple policies can reduce school segregation while preserving varying degrees of proximity, choice, and predictability. Zone-based policies with reserves reduce the concentration of racial minority students in high-poverty schools and maintain proximity, but reduce choice. District-wide choice with reserves and distance-based priority can further reduce segregation, but at the cost of predictability. Tradeoffs are necessary as no policy dominates another policy. In addition, we show that spatial segregation indices capture average patterns in these tradeoffs but miss important variation revealed by our simulation framework. Our work informed the design and approval of a zone-based policy in San Francisco in 2020, and supports ongoing policy implementation.
